prompt: A young adult East Asian woman stands beneath a clear sky, with fair warm-toned skin, a softly rounded face, dark almond-shaped eyes, shoulder-length black hair, wispy bangs, and a curvy build. Wind blows her hair outward, with several loose strands crossing her cheeks. She tilts her head slightly downward, her gaze falling approximately toward the smartphone screen in the right foreground, lips naturally parted and expression calm and focused. She wears a black thin-strapped low-cut top with bare shoulders and holds a silver-gray smartphone in a pale gray case; three large rear camera lenses are visible, with no readable branding. The background contains only a vivid blue sky and luminous white clouds concentrated on the left, with no horizon. Use a vertical 3:4 composition, an approximately 24-28mm wide-angle perspective, and a very low-angle close upper-body portrait. Place her slightly left of center, with her face in the upper middle and her chest and shoulders filling the lower half. The nearby hand and phone are enlarged by perspective, slightly out of focus, and cropped by the right edge. Strong sunlight near the upper-left edge creates backlighting, broad blown highlights, diagonal light rays, lens flare, soft haze, and subtle bloom. Flying strands of hair glow with warm golden rim light, while delicate hair shadows fall across her skin and clothing; soft skylight evenly fills her face. Use a bright palette of sky blue, milky white, warm peach skin, and deep black, with translucent low contrast and a slight pastel pink-blue cast. Photorealistic, fresh summer portrait photography with shallow depth of field: the face is relatively sharp while the phone, fingers, and clouds are gently softened. Preserve fine natural skin texture, softly controlled sharpness, low noise, extremely subtle grain, and naturally accurate facial features, hand anatomy, and phone geometry.
